scope: Complete declared schedules on fixed CIFAR-10 10000/2000 and PennFudan 120/50 splits; not full ImageNet/COCO convergence
selection: Final epoch only; no best-checkpoint or best-seed selection

equivalence.method: paired Student t two one-sided tests (TOST)
equivalence.interpretation: Equivalence of the mean metric over training seeds on this fixed holdout, not bitwise identity or COCO generalization

faster_rcnn.provenance: Unmodified original UP R50-FPN architecture in both source trees

resnet18.provenance: Unmodified original UP ResNet18 architecture in both source trees

detr.provenance: External pinned facebookresearch/detr R50 6-encoder/6-decoder adapter, identical in both UP trees; NOT an upstream UP model
